inference_env.env_var_required: PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=win32 (PyOpenGL otherwise selects the EGL backend, which is absent on Windows)
inference_env.cwd_required: repo root, because the WiLoR cfg uses the relative path ./mano_data/mano_mean_params.npz

analysis_env.note: scikit-learn is not installed; ridge regression and PCA are implemented in closed form with numpy, which is deterministic and keeps the preprocessing explicit

latent_layer.why: the image encoder's final feature map, before the MANO and camera heads consume it. Chosen on architecture semantics before any target was read.
latent_layer.pooling: global average pool over the two spatial axes -> (B, 1280)
latent_layer.extraction_method: forward hook; no model source is modified

determinism: AnyCalib target reused frozen; hand inference is a single deterministic forward pass per frame; all shuffles use fixed seeds
